derivation:
by
  simpa [Module.Basis.constr_self, LinearMap.range_comp] using
    (b.constr_range ℕ (f := fun i => (f.comp p.subtype) (b i)))
explanation: Instantiate constr_range with the images of the basis vectors under f.comp p.subtype. The constructed map simplifies to that composition, whose range is p.map f.
